components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:9999px;padding:.625rem 1.25rem;font:500 .875rem/1.25rem system-ui;cursor:pointer;transition:background-position .3s ease-out,color .3s ease-out,border-color .3s ease-out;border:1px solid var(--border-color,#253134);background:var(--surface,#11191b);color:var(--fg,#f5f7f7)}.ds-button:hover{border-color:var(--fg,#f5f7f7)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#58e5d0);outline-offset:2px;}
components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-nav{transition:background-color .3s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s;padding:.75rem;background:rgb(8 12 13/.7);border-bottom:1px solid rgb(var(--brand-mid-rgb,88 229 208)/.3);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgb(0 0 0/.45)}.ds-nav-link{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid rgb(var(--brand-mid-rgb,88 229 208)/.4);border-radius:9999px;padding:.625rem 1.25rem;background:rgb(var(--brand-deep-rgb,15 110 104)/.2);color:var(--fg,#f5f7f7);font:500 .875rem/1.25rem system-ui;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav-link:hover{background:rgb(var(--brand-deep-rgb,15 110 104)/.35)}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#58e5d0)}

motion.name: section-entrance
motion.purpose: Arrival easing in homepage section styles.

motion.name: mobile-menu-enter
motion.purpose: Open the menu and backdrop together.

motion.name: mobile-menu-exit
motion.purpose: Fade the menu and backdrop together. Escape and reduced motion close immediately.

motion.name: fixed-header-transition
motion.purpose: Animate background color, border color, and box shadow. Apply compact blur immediately.

motion.name: experience-progress
motion.purpose: Scale the timeline progress from the left. Reduced motion applies the update immediately.

motion.name: terminal-intro
motion.purpose: First-visit terminal timeline. A 6.5s fallback hides the curtain if normal dismissal does not run.

motion.name: hero-scroll-cue
motion.purpose: Draw attention to the About link twice. Reduced motion keeps the cue static.

headline.purpose: Homepage section headings request Sora at CSS weight 500.

dos: use semantic surface, text, border, and ring tokens on public and admin routes.
use the brighter ink gradient for gradient text and the action gradient for fills under white text.
keep functional text at 11px or larger.
use the brand RGB channel variables when giving decorative glows an alpha value.
preserve keyboard focus treatments and static media under reduced motion.
donts: add a separate runtime palette or an unlayered global reset.
narrative.overview: Aristache has a technical, cinematic visual identity. Section media, near-black surfaces, and turquoise accents give the homepage depth. The same dark palette carries through navigation, dialogs, and the admin interface.
